title: Hub envelope
description: Every message on the wire, in both directions. The Hub routes on `type`, `sender` and `recipient`; it does not interpret `payload`.

payload.description: Opaque to the Hub. For `type: message` this is one of the payload types in payloads.schema.json.

timestamp.description: Unix seconds, set by the sender. Informational: never used for correlation.

id.description: Empty string is allowed for `hub`, which is a singleton.
